crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: civfix hit an unexpected problem. Restarting clears the data it had saved and tries again.

scan.title: Scan a ticket
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR code on the attendee's ticket.

gate.title: Camera access
gate.body: civfix uses the camera to read the QR code on an attendee's ticket at check-in.
gate.no_camera_body: This device has no available camera. Type the ticket code instead.
